def factory(v):
    return lambda: v

print("=== Five loops. Which give [0, 1, 2]? ===")

a = [lambda: i for i in range(3)]
b = [lambda i=i: i for i in range(3)]
c = [factory(i) for i in range(3)]
d = []
for i in range(3):
    d.append(lambda: i)
e = []
for i in range(3):
    e.append(factory(i))

                  ("e  for-loop, factory         ", e)]:
    print(f"  {name} -> {[f() for f in fns]}")
